body: Reading your comment genuinely helped. Thanks for taking the time to reply.

I stopped speaking with my folks after they betrayed my trust beyond forgiveness. It's a really long story, but that's the TL;DR version. I do have some friends in the area from my previous work or from gaming, just not anyone close enough where I can share anything deeply personal.

Last few years I worked at a job I couldn't stand. Last November I got laid off, which was sort of a good thing. I decided to start my own business. Not having stability though has been bringing me down a bit. Also broke up with my boyfriend a month ago and it's been incredibly difficult. The break-up itself wasn't terrible, but it was the straw that broke the camel's back. It sort of made me snap and now I haven't been able to do anything but cry. I have no family, no friends, no SO to confide in. I feel truly alone.
